title: Bluetooth widget doesn't show some devices' battery state, despite it being shown in the Power and Battery widget
line: The Bluetooth widget now shows the battery level of game controllers like the DualSense, which only report it through the system's power service.
explanation: The Bluetooth applet only read battery levels from BlueZ's Battery1 interface. Devices like the DualSense report their battery through the kernel HID driver, which UPower picks up (with the controller's Bluetooth address as serial, from the HID uniq) but BlueZ never sees, so only the Power and Battery widget showed it. A new PowerSupplyBatteries QML singleton watches Solid's non-power-supply batteries and maps their serial to the charge percentage; the device list and the tooltip fall back to it when a device has no BlueZ battery.

commits.message:
applet: show battery of devices that report it outside BlueZ

Game controllers like the DualSense report their battery through the
kernel and UPower rather than BlueZ, so the applet showed no level for
them. It now falls back to the UPower battery matching their address.

BUG: 505394

media.caption: Connected DualSense: no battery in the Bluetooth popup

review.text: Correct cause (DualSense battery only reaches UPower via the kernel HID driver, never BlueZ) and a clean fallback: a small Solid-based singleton keyed by the battery serial, which UPower sets to the HID uniq/MAC. BlueZ batteries still take priority, live updates and removal were tested, and Solid is already a CI dependency. Media show the battery appearing in popup and tooltip.
